findings.title: Back navigation restores pre-flush Analytics filters
findings.problem: The debounce's leading call writes filter A to the URL and to storage. A trailing change B, made within 2 s of leaving, is flushed on unmount to storage only (by design, AC8). If the user returns with browser Back, the history entry still carries ?A. resolveInitialFilters and the useAnalyticsFilters effect prefer valid URL params, so A is shown, and the effect's storage.put overwrites the flushed B.
findings.impact: On a Back-button return, the last change before leaving is silently lost. That is the scenario AC3 targets. A fix needs a change to URL-over-storage priority or to history handling, and the spec lists URL-over-storage priority as a non-goal, so the correct behaviour needs human intent.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether a return through browser Back must keep the trailing change. If it must, then one of two changes is needed, and both touch spec non-goals. Either let a storage record newer than the URL win in resolveInitialFilters and the useAnalyticsFilters effect, or record the flushed value in the analytics history entry. If it need not, record that as an accepted limit of AC3 in the spec.

findings.title: Clear-all before unmount flush is untested
findings.problem: handleClearFilters sets pendingFiltersRef.current = null so the new unmount flush cannot write a stale pending change over a clear. No test clicks 'Clear all': the AnalyticsFilters flush tests cover only a pending trailing change and a single leading change. The AnalyticsPage 'keeps cleared filters cleared' test mocks AnalyticsFilters and calls onFiltersChange({}) directly, so it never exercises the real debounce plus flush path. Gap shape: regression-gap, so AC9 is only partially met.
findings.impact: If the reset line is dropped, the sequence change, change, Clear all, navigate away restores the old filters on return. That is the regression the ticket targets (AC7), and no test would fail. The consumer is useAnalyticsFilters.resolveInitialFilters, which reads the stored filters back on remount.
findings.recommendation: In AnalyticsFilters.test.tsx, under the 'flush pending change on unmount (EPMCDME-16054)' describe, add a test that: makes two project changes inside the debounce window, clicks 'Clear all', unmounts and advances timers. Assert that localStorage 'user-1_filters_analytics' does not hold the pending projects and that onFiltersChange was last called with DEFAULT_FILTERS. Optionally add an AnalyticsPage remount case that drives the real AnalyticsFilters rather than calling onFiltersChange({}) directly.

findings.title: No remount test for cleared budget filter
findings.problem: AC9 requires unmount/remount tests that assert cleared values on each screen. For budget filters, the Projects persistence suite only has 'restores budget assignment and category into the first request'. It has no case where a cleared budget assignment or category stays cleared after a remount; only cleared search and reset sort are covered.
findings.impact: A story acceptance criterion ships only partially met. A regression that restores a cleared budget filter on return (AC7) would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add an unmount/remount test for each budget filter (assignment, category): store a value, clear it, then remount. Assert that the control shows no value and that indexProjects is called without the budget param. Model it on 'keeps a cleared search cleared after unmount and remount'.
